analytic_direction_only.candidate_bound: For a serial load-to-compute chain with independent load/compute engines, completion is bounded below by max over contiguous cut points of (load-prefix service + compute-suffix service). A bounded homogeneous segment can be summarized by its signed service difference and endpoint extrema.
